I summarize the interpretation in three statements.
Standards govern what
enters the analytical pipeline.
Workflow design governs what information survives it,
and validation design governs what claims can leave it.
In our experiment, standards changed the records.
Common spatial processing determined whether that difference persisted,
and geographic validation determined the strength of the predictive claims
we could make.
